# HOURGLASS

> An editorial calculator that converts a daily habit into its lifetime total.
> Enter an activity, the hours a day it takes, and the number of years, and it
> returns the result in days, weeks, and waking years. The journal applies the
> same arithmetic to one habit at a time, with named sources.

A waking year is 365 x 16 = 5,840 hours, which is the convention used
throughout the site: totals are reported in conscious time, with sleep removed.
Figures come from published research, most often the American Time Use Survey,
the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Nielsen, and Pew Research. Sources are named in
the text rather than footnoted.

## Core

- [Calculator](https://www.justhourglass.me/): the tool itself.
- [Journal](https://www.justhourglass.me/journal): all 47 articles.
- [Philosophy](https://www.justhourglass.me/philosophy): on the arithmetic of attention.
- [About](https://www.justhourglass.me/about): what the site is and why it exists.
